g.text: PCAC convention: what is required now and what is to be built
use only registered or filed agents
agreement: limits, account and priority, validity
verify the user's identity and intent to pay
pay only within what was authorised
KYA: identify and verify the agent
manage agents by high, medium, low risk
pass identity and tier along the payment chain
approach autonomous payment itself with care
Art. 26 safeguards: human handling, risk monitoring, complaint and reputation monitoring, emergency response, fallback
